message:
fix(multicursor): revert "]C"/"[C" cursor-plopping behavior #42034

Problem:
Jumping to a cursor adds one at the old position, so navigation has a
side-effect. "]CQ" no longer deletes a cursor, and returning with "[C"
after wandering off adds a cursor wherever you were.

This is useful in some cases, but as a default it is surprising. The
default behavior should be simple and composable.

Solution:
Revert the "]C"/"[C" cursor-plopping behavior.
Document a mapping for the "rotate" behavior.
